Completion date is source-supplied and has no single formal definition; do not overstate it as public opening or full occupation. Planning permission, work-start, and construction-completion dates must remain separate event types. Coordinates are point locations from LDD Easting/Northing fields; they are not footprints or precise entrance locations. Figures relate to permission gains/losses and can differ from descriptions, especially phased schemes or split permissions. Local planning authority records should be checked before promoting any candidate to canonical event status. Use selected rows as candidate development-completion records with visible provenance, source row references, coordinates caveats, and no claim of opening/occupation/outcomes. The LDD notes all data was supplied by planning authorities and may be updated/corrected; consult the relevant local planning authority for definitive planning documents. Completed Date has no formal single definition in the LDD notes; it may normally be a building-control completion certificate date, or a planning-authority judgement that the permission is complete or ready for occupation. Coordinates are source point locations converted from British National Grid and should not be used as footprints or precise entrances. Figures describe losses/gains associated with the permission and may not describe unaffected uses on the site.

This is an archived LDD planning/development completion-status record. Completed Date has no formal single definition in the LDD notes and may reflect a building-control completion certificate or planning-authority judgement. It is not evidence of public opening, occupation, current use, service delivery, final built form, design quality, local outcomes, or outcome relationships. Some rows may represent phases, outline permissions, reserved matters, variations, or administrative updates.
